snippet.title: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Demons told me to make this trailer. You see, it's for this game I'm making, also because the Demons told me to. 

The game in question is a nonlinear dark comedy / Eldritch horror narrative adventure, featuring a colorful cast of charismatic people and terrifying demons, a mysterious little town of American Midwest, and a healthy forkful of time loop shenanigans.

Created by Haunted Dude. 

Please wishlist on Steam. The demons said they'd let me sleep if you wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835690/The_Demons_Told_Me_to_Make_This_Game
